questions.evidence: [Interview] Reporter: Will the reading room open every evening? Principal: We hope to try that next month, but only if we can find enough adult helpers. At present, the room closes at five. We will announce a decision next Friday.

The designer's claim about attracting readers.

questions.evidence: [Poster draft] GOOD NEWS! Reading room open every evening from next month. Stay as long as you want! A student designer says the short headline will attract more readers than a sentence full of conditions.

A possible change concerns next month.
Students may stay for an unlimited time.
An announcement will provide more information.
